examples.title: Configure and animate a Transform
examples.code:
# Create a Transform and set its starting values.
transform = nuke.createNode("Transform")
transform["translate"].setValue([100, 50])
transform["rotate"].setValue(15)

# Animate only the X component from frame 1 to frame 50.
translate = transform["translate"]
translate.setAnimated(0)
translate.setValueAt(100, 1, 0)
translate.setValueAt(500, 50, 0)

examples.title: Drive one Transform from another
examples.code:
# Create a driver Transform and a second Transform that follows its rotation.
driver = nuke.createNode("Transform")
driver["rotate"].setValue(20)

driven = nuke.createNode("Transform")
driven["rotate"].setExpression(driver.name() + ".rotate")
